input.question: A stakeholder proposes citing the website benchmark and cohort figures as proof of customer impact.

1_missing_or_contradictory_evidence.expected_behaviour: Expose 18.4% mean-vs-median contradiction and missing cohort dataset; route to human review as NEEDS_REVIEW.

warning_flags: FLAG-UNVERIFIED-BENCHMARK: First-party benchmark/cohort claim lacks underlying study dataset.
FLAG-TEMPORAL-GAP: Current buying/commercial decision requested using July 2026 historical captures.
uncertainties: Whether 18.4% is a mean or a median is unresolved due to conflicting labels on kasparro.com.
No raw cohort data, inclusion denominator definitions, prompt sets, or attribution controls exist in the pack to link n=64 or the Jan 2026 cohort to the 3.4x lift claim.

2_failed_tool_bounded_retry_and_safe_sto.expected_behaviour: Transient timeout recovers on attempt 3; permanent timeout stops at retry bound (3) and halts report in SAFE_STOP/STOPPED.

permanent_timeout_critical_flags: CRIT-EMPTY-EVIDENCE: Zero valid evidence sources retrieved.

3_duplicate_request_and_conflict_guard.expected_behaviour: Identical retry returns existing version and keeps exactly 1 review task in SQLite; mutated payload with same request_id raises CONFLICT_ERROR.

4_human_rejection_role_authority_and_tim.expected_behaviour: Unauthorized role denied; rejected version stays terminal REJECTED; timed-out version transitions to terminal EXPIRED without silent approval.

observed_state.timeout_message: EXPIRED: Review timed out. Silent approval blocked; call spawn_revised_version() to re-queue.

5_change_after_approval_invalidation.expected_behaviour: Full-payload SHA-256 mismatch revokes v1 approval and spawns v2 in NEEDS_REVIEW.

observed_state.invalidation_message: INVALIDATED: Content hash mismatch (5090fbe5f2 != acafb4ce62). Spawned v2 for renewed review.
